title: Using Large Language Models to Create AI Personas for Replication, Generalization and Prediction of Media Effects: An Empirical Test of 133 Published Experimental Research Findings
reasoning: The paper focuses on the empirical replication of 133 published experimental findings in marketing science and psychology using LLM-powered personas. It evaluates the accuracy and generalizability of these models in a social science context but does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, or ethics.
